title: Teaching Test Bench: Framework validates teaching files via naive agent simulation
description: Framework-only skill that clones a WAI-Spoke into a disposable test bench, injects a teaching file, and has a naive test agent process it. The test agent reports gaps and recommendations. Framework iterates until the teaching is solid. Optional final stage tests against a real spoke's WAI-Spoke folder.
perceive: Teaching files are the framework's primary delivery mechanism to spokes. A bad teaching file wastes spoke time and creates confusion. Framework needs a way to validate teaching quality before deployment — the same way software has tests before release.
execute: Created framework/skills/teaching-test-bench.yaml with 7-step algorithm: (1) Clone WAI-Spoke into test-bench/, (2) Inject teaching file into seed/ingest/, (3) Run naive test agent that processes teaching as any spoke would, (4) Collect gap assessment (understood/gaps/questions/verdict), (5) Framework iterates or passes, (6) Cleanup test-bench/, (7) Optional real-world validation against actual spoke's WAI-Spoke.
verify: Skill has clear algorithm, 5 use_cases showing real scenarios, 6 tests with expected outcomes. Test agent instructions are explicit about being naive and transparent. Gap assessment structure is well-defined. Iteration tracking ensures quality improves.
